question: A parallel plate capacitor has plate area $2 \times 10^{-3}\,\text{m}^2$ and plate separation $1\,\text{mm}$. A dielectric of constant $4$ completely fills the space between the plates. Calculate its capacitance. Take $\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}\,\text{C}^2\text{N}^{-1}\text{m}^{-2}$.
